# Results -- Study 764 (SOPR) on the real BTC monthly tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Recipe: join the
curated month-end **SOPR** series (Spent Output Profit Ratio) to BTC-USD monthly
closes; test whether a *momentum / regime* read of SOPR (above 1 = coins in
profit = bullish, below 1 = coins at a loss = capitulation) predicts next-month
returns and whether the literal ">1 / <1" timing rule beats simply holding BTC.
**Single-survivor**: BTC is the one crypto that ~150x'd over the aligned sample
and SOPR is computed from its own on-chain spending -- all results are
conditioned on that survival.
As-of **2026-07-13**.*

## Data stamp

| Source | Window | Shape | Fingerprint (last row) |
|--------|--------|-------|----------------------|
| Curated aSOPR (digitised proxy, ~2 dp) | 2014-01-31 -> 2026-06-30 | 150 month-ends | `e006bb91ef6d` |
| yfinance BTC-USD monthly close | 2014-09-30 -> 2026-06-30 | 142 aligned months | `998f962478c6` |

The SOPR series is hardcoded in [`sopr/data.py`](../sopr/data.py)
(`SOPR_MONTHLY`), a **labelled proxy** digitised from the public Glassnode
"Adjusted SOPR" chart -- it is *not* a live Glassnode feed. The real BTC tape is
cache-only (`_cache/btc_monthly.parquet`); offline runs fall back to the frozen
numbers below. The join stops at the last SOPR month (2026-06-30), so the
in-progress July bar is dropped (no partial-month contamination).

## Primary specification -- predictive regression

`r(t+1) = a + b * log(SOPR_t / 1.0) + e`

| Spec | Slope b | HAC *t* | R^2 | n |
|------|---------|---------|-----|---|
| SOPR stretch -> next-month BTC log-return | **+0.95** | **+1.32** | 0.013 | 141 |

The slope is the *right sign* for the momentum story (positive: SOPR above 1
should precede a higher next return) but is **statistically indistinguishable
from zero** -- HAC *t* = +1.32, R^2 ~ 0.01. SOPR stretch carries no robust
forward predictive content for next-month BTC returns.

### Horse race vs price momentum

| Regressor | HAC *t* |
|-----------|---------|
| SOPR stretch | +0.18 |
| BTC 1-month price momentum | +1.04 |

With BTC's own momentum in the regression, the SOPR slope collapses to *t* =
+0.18. Whatever faint directional whiff SOPR carries is not incremental to the
price trend -- SOPR is largely a re-labelling of "was last month up or down."

## Average next-month return by SOPR band

| Band | Next-month return | Hit rate | n months |
|------|-------------------|----------|----------|
| Greed (SOPR >= 1.02) | +8.87%/mo | 0.59 | 44 |
| Neutral (0.98 < SOPR < 1.02) | +4.75%/mo | 0.54 | 67 |
| Capitulation (SOPR <= 0.98) | +2.60%/mo | 0.53 | 30 |

The ordering is *monotone in the folk direction* -- greed months do precede
higher average returns than capitulation months -- which is the grain of truth
that keeps the indicator alive. But the gap is not significant (the regression
*t* is only 1.32), it dies entirely in the price-momentum horse race, and, as
the backtest shows, it is *unhelpful for timing*: every month spent out of a
150x asset costs more than the ranking saves.

## Tradability -- ">1 / <1" regime timing vs buy-and-hold

Rule: be long BTC for month t+1 whenever SOPR >= 1.0, step to cash otherwise
(long/flat, no short, no borrow). One-way 30 bps charged on every flip x NAV.
Price-only (BTC pays no yield).

| Strategy | CAGR | Ann. Sharpe | HAC *t* |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| SOPR regime timing (net 30 bps) | +59.7%/yr | +0.98 | +2.61 |
| Buy-and-hold BTC | +67.0%/yr | +0.93 | +2.66 |
| **Timing minus buy-hold** | **-7.3%/yr** | -- | **-0.73** |

- Time in market **62.0%**, average turnover **0.255/mo** -- the rule is out of
  the market 38% of the time, and it gives up **-7.3%/yr** of return versus
  simply holding (HAC *t* = -0.73). It slightly *raises* Sharpe (0.98 vs 0.93)
  by dodging some drawdown, but on a single asset that ~150x'd, sitting in cash
  during the capitulation months -- which historically *precede rebounds* -- is
  exactly the wrong trade.
- Threshold sweep: tighten to SOPR >= 1.01 (+54.9%/yr) or loosen to >= 0.99
  (+59.5%/yr) and every variant *trails* buy-and-hold. There is no threshold at
  which the rule wins.

## Placebo -- shuffle SOPR in time

Destroy any real SOPR->return alignment by permuting the SOPR values in time
(2000 draws) and re-running the exact rule:

| Quantity | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Real rule edge over buy-hold | -0.61%/mo |
| Placebo edge (mean) | -2.25%/mo |
| Placebo edge (std) | 0.83 pp |
| Two-sided empirical *p* | 0.975 |

A *random* long/flat schedule with the same ~62% in-market share loses ~2.25%/mo
to buy-and-hold (missing a chunk of a strongly-trending asset is costly by
construction). The real SOPR rule loses *less* than that -- so SOPR does time
marginally better than a coin flip -- but it **still loses to buy-and-hold
outright**, and its edge is nowhere near the extreme tail (p = 0.975). "Beats
random, loses to holding" is the signature of a weak, untradable regime filter.

## Positive control -- the machinery finds the link when planted

On the deterministic synthetic tape (`data.synthetic_series`) the same
regression recovers a planted *momentum* link and reads ~zero on the null:

| Planted momentum beta | Slope | HAC *t* |
|-----------------------|-------|---------|
| 2.0 | +1.286 | **+5.75** |
| 0.0 (null) | -0.047 | -0.21 |

The engine is truthful: it detects a momentum SOPR->price link when one exists
and reads zero when it does not. The real tape simply has no link strong enough
to clear the bar.

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** SOPR stretch does not robustly predict next-month BTC
  returns (HAC *t* = +1.32, R^2 ~ 0.01); the slope collapses to *t* = +0.18 in a
  price-momentum horse race. The monotone band ordering (greed > neutral >
  capitulation) is the grain of truth, but no *t* clears 2 on the real tape.
  Verdict: **NONE**.
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** The ">1 / <1" rule *loses* 7.3%/yr to buy-and-hold
  (HAC *t* = -0.73) and trails at every threshold; the placebo confirms it beats
  a coin flip yet still can't beat holding. Any apparent CAGR is just long
  exposure to a 150x survivor, and 38% time-in-cash forfeits part of it.
  Verdict: **MIRAGE**.
- **Single-survivor -- named.** BTC is the surviving moonshot and SOPR is
  computed from its own on-chain spending; the regime rule is fitted to ~four
  cycle turns. All results are conditioned on that survival.
